description: This file defines a set of color-related utilities for highlighting menu items, including a palette structure and functions to determine primary and secondary highlight colors based on a boolean 'highlighted' state.

classes.name: Palette
classes.description: A structure that holds primary and secondary Color values for menu item highlighting.

methods.name: primary
methods.description: Returns the primary highlight color based on whether the menu item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary
methods.description: Returns the secondary highlight color with reduced opacity when highlighted.

methods.name: palette
methods.description: Generates a Palette instance containing primary and secondary colors based on highlight state.
